note: Tre polimorfi conformazionali di un cocristallo ionico (ICC) di hesperetin (HES) con il suo sale di tetraetilammonio, HESTEA = (TEA+HES–)HES, C40H47NO12: HESTEA-α, -β, -γ (Table 1: tutti monoclini, Z 4, T 135 K). Dettagli sperimentali (quantita' degli slurry, velocita' del DSC, tempi e temperature degli slurry competitivi) stanno solo nelle Supporting Information e non si estraggono. Sorgenti di confronto citate senza evento: «HES hydrate (FOYTOC)» con anelli quasi paralleli (3.69°) e sette voci HES del CSD (Table S3), usate solo per le torsioni. HESTEA-α e' presentato come «disappearing polymorph» (non riottenibile dopo l'isolamento di β e γ): preparazione non ottenuta. Densita' a 135 K (Table 1): α 1.328 < γ 1.336 < β 1.343 g·cm–3, usate dagli autori come indizio che α e' la meno stabile. Nelle prove di DSC la forma di arrivo del primo evento di α e' solo «a new phase» vista in vt-PXRD (pattern diverso dai tre polimorfi); la sua fusione a ca. 193 °C e' attribuita da noi a quella fase (il testo dice solo «followed by a larger endotherm ... which we attribute to melting»).

motivi_hb.citazione: which reveals a chain of HES molecules connected through O–H···O=C H-bonds [2.6911(68) Å].

forme.citazione: HES crystallized in the space group P21/c with one molecule in the asymmetric unit.

forme.protonazione: un anione HES– (fenolato) e una molecola neutra HES per catione TEA+

motivi_hb.chi: one phenolate and three phenolic groups from two HES– anions and two HES molecules (PhOH···PhO– and PhOH···PhOH)
motivi_hb.citazione: which results in a C32(7) H-bonded motif comprising one phenolate and three phenolic groups from two HES– anions and two HES molecules, as illustrated in Figure 1a.

motivi_hb.citazione: Each polymorph was found to be sustained by phenol···phenolate supramolecular heterosynthons that self-assemble with phenol···phenol supramolecular homosynthons into C32(7) H-bonded motifs.

motivi_hb.chi: HES molecules (helical chains along b) and HES– anions (zigzag chains along a)
motivi_hb.citazione: In these sheets, HES molecules form helical chains around 2-fold screw axes through PhOH···PhOH H-bonds that propagate along the b-axis while HES– anions form zigzag chains through PhOH···PhO– H-bonds that propagate along the a-axis (Figure 1b).

forme.citazione: HESTEA-α crystallized in the space group P21/n with an asymmetric unit comprising one TEA+ cation, one HES– anion, and one HES molecule.
forme.note: Cella, Z, Z′, T e CCDC dalla colonna HESTEA-α di Table 1. Densita' 1.328 g·cm–3 a 135 K. «Disappearing polymorph»: non e' stato possibile rifarlo.

forme.protonazione: un anione HES– (fenolato) e una molecola neutra HES per catione TEA+

motivi_hb.chi: two PhOH···PhO– and one PhOH···PhOH H-bonds between one phenolate and three phenolic groups
motivi_hb.citazione: Like HESTEA-α, C32(7) H-bonded motifs are formed and comprise two PhOH···PhO– and one PhOH···PhOH H-bonds between one phenolate and three phenolic groups.

motivi_hb.chi: phenolate of HES– and phenolic groups of HES / HES–
motivi_hb.citazione: Each polymorph was found to be sustained by phenol···phenolate supramolecular heterosynthons that self-assemble with phenol···phenol supramolecular homosynthons into C32(7) H-bonded motifs.

motivi_hb.chi: H-bonded sheets forming cavities that contain TEA+ cations
motivi_hb.citazione: When viewed down the c-axis, adjacent H-bonded sheets interdigitate with each other through weak H-bonds and form cavities containing TEA+ cations that are engaged in C–H···O and columbic forces (Figure 2c).

forme.citazione: HESTEA-β crystallized in the space group P21/c with an asymmetric unit containing one TEA+ cation, one HES– anion and one HES molecule.
forme.note: Cella, Z, Z′, T e CCDC dalla colonna HESTEA-β di Table 1. Densita' 1.343 g·cm–3.

forme.protonazione: legame H apparentemente simmetrico fra due HES: il protone sta su o vicino all'asse binario cristallografico ([PhO···H···PhO–]); i cationi TEA+ sono disordinati attorno a un centro di inversione

motivi_hb.motivo: C32(7) motif with symmetric or close-to-symmetric [PhO···H···PhO–] anion
motivi_hb.chi: [PhO···H···PhO–] anions and two phenolic groups of neighboring HES moieties
motivi_hb.citazione: As illustrated in Figure 3a, [PhO···H···PhO–] anions form H-bonds with two phenolic groups on the methoxy-substituted phenolic rings from two neighboring HES moieties [O2···O6, 2.663(2) Å], which forms a C32(7) motif (Figure 3a).

motivi_hb.chi: phenolate of HES– and phenolic groups of HES
motivi_hb.citazione: Each polymorph was found to be sustained by phenol···phenolate supramolecular heterosynthons that self-assemble with phenol···phenol supramolecular homosynthons into C32(7) H-bonded motifs.

motivi_hb.motivo: bilayer of H-bonded tapes along the c-axis
motivi_hb.chi: C32(7) motifs with antiparallel face-to-face HES moieties
motivi_hb.citazione: In the H-bonded motifs, HES moieties align in an antiparallel face-to-face arrangement (4.363 Å between two benzopyrone rings), thereby forming a bilayer of tapes along the c-axis (Figure 3b).

forme.citazione: HESTEA-γ crystallized in the space group C2/c with an asymmetric unit comprising 0.5 of the chemical formula since TEA+ cations are disordered around an inversion center and an apparently symmetric H-bond between HES moieties enables the proton to sit at or close to a crystallographic 2-fold axis.
forme.note: Cella, Z, Z′ 0.5, T e CCDC dalla colonna HESTEA-γ di Table 1. Densita' 1.336 g·cm–3. Gli autori non asseriscono la simmetria del legame H («cannot be asserted using SCXRD»).

forme.citazione: vt-PXRD data (Figure 5) also reveals a phase change by 180 °C to a new crystal form with a different PXRD to that of any of the three polymorphs characterized by SCXRD.

citazioni: The thermal properties of the three HESTEA polymorphs were investigated by means of thermogravimetric analysis (TGA), differential scanning calorimetry (DSC), and variable temperature powder X-ray diffraction (vt-PXRD).

The DSC curve (Figure S3b) of HESTEA-α displayed two endothermal events, the first being consistent with transformation to a new phase at ca. 182 °C followed by a larger endotherm at ca. 193 °C, which we attribute to melting.
vt-PXRD data (Figure 5) also reveals a phase change by 180 °C to a new crystal form with a different PXRD to that of any of the three polymorphs characterized by SCXRD.
eventi.note: Transizione di HESTEA-α a una fase nuova: DSC «ca. 182 °C» (primo di due endotermi, «consistent with transformation to a new phase»); il vt-PXRD (Figura 5) vede il cambio di fase «by 180 °C». Un solo evento per le due tecniche (stessa transizione, temperature coerenti); la T del vt-PXRD e' nel testo. Velocita' di riscaldamento non detta nel testo (supplementare).

citazioni: The thermal properties of the three HESTEA polymorphs were investigated by means of thermogravimetric analysis (TGA), differential scanning calorimetry (DSC), and variable temperature powder X-ray diffraction (vt-PXRD).
TGA data revealed that HESTEA-α, -β, and -γ each decomposed at ca. 240 °C, slightly lower than pure HES, which decomposed at ca. 260 °C (Figure S3a).
eventi.note: Hesperetin puro «decomposed at ca. 260 °C» (TGA, Figura S3a); avviene dopo la fusione a 232 °C (E7).

These competitive slurry experiments revealed that HESTEA-α transformed into one of the other polymorphs in all three solvents.

Under competitive slurry conditions, HESTEA-α was observed to transform to the β or γ forms. Solvent selection impacted the relationship between HESTEA-β (favored in EtOH) and HESTEA-γ (favored in MeOH). A mixture of the β and γ forms was found to be present following H2O slurry.

descrizioni.testo: benzopyrone rings of HES moieties show a high degree of torsional variability; torsion angles cannot be readily determined because of disorder of the chiral carbons
descrizioni.citazione: As seen by aligning the methoxy phenolic moieties, the benzopyrone rings exhibit a high degree of torsional variability, but disorder of the chiral carbons means that torsion angles cannot be readily determined.

descrizioni.testo: dihedral angle between benzopyrone ring and methoxy phenolic ring: 3.69° in HES hydrate (FOYTOC), 4.69° to 89.06° in HES cocrystals
descrizioni.citazione: In HES cocrystals, HES moieties exhibit dihedral angles that range from 4.69° to 89.06°.

descrizioni.testo: HES molecule perpendicular to HES– anion, dihedral angle between benzopyrone ring planes 88.94° (HESTEA-α)
descrizioni.citazione: HES molecules in HESTEA-α and HESTEA-β are arranged perpendicular in relation to the corresponding HES– anions, with dihedral angles (measured between benzopyrone ring planes from HES and HES–) of 88.94° and 76.92°, respectively.

descrizioni.testo: HES moieties closer to planarity, dihedral angle between two benzopyrone rings 30.09° (HESTEA-γ)

descrizioni.testo: flavonoid with multiple phenolic groups (medium strength H-bond donors)
